name: ensure the network fix persists for the grading run
definition: Apply the fix so it is effective when the grader performs its own fetch after the setup ends (not relying on a one-off command in the setup session).
failure_mode: A transient fix that doesn't persist leaves the later fetch failing.

name: enumerate permitted sudo commands for the current user
definition: Discover which binaries the current user may execute with elevated privileges.
failure_mode: Not inspecting sudo grants leaves the route to the file undiscovered.
